title: Reporting Schedule
description: The period and deadline contract from which reporting obligations are created. Every elapsed period produces an obligation even when it has zero rows or production fails, so a consumer can distinguish empty from missing.

period_duration.description: ISO 8601 duration of each reporting period, such as PT15M, P1D, or P1M.

alignment.description: Calendar used to establish exact period boundaries. The obligation echoes resolved timestamps and source timezone.

delivery_sla.description: Maximum time after period end before the required revision is due. expected_at equals the resolved period end plus this duration.
